plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-10 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Criminal Justice (BA/BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Criminal Justice Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Criminal Justice (Campus)', last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the B.S.: the catalog prints Total Credits, B.S. Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly (8 semesters of 15), while the B.A. total is printed as 120-124 because the 16 credits of foreign language are expressly not included in the map. Disclosed: the map places CJ 4200 Ethical Issues in Criminal Justice and CJ 4990 Criminal Justice Capstone as named rows in Year 4; the catalog program page's core list names only CJ 1010, CJ 1330, CJ 2500 and CJ 3270 plus 30 credits of major electives, so the two Year 4 courses are transcribed as printed in the map without reclassifying them. Elective rows are choice slots with synthetic codes.
